description: This file defines a React component for a navigation bar in a book tracking web application. It includes subcomponents, styling, and navigation links with icons, and manages theme-based logo display.

classes.name: NavItem
classes.description: A functional component representing a navigation item with an icon and text, linking to a specified route.

methods.name: NavItem
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a navigation item with an icon and label, wrapped in a link.

methods.name: NavBar
methods.description: Main React component that renders the navigation bar with theme-aware logo and navigation links.
